A '''starship''' was owned by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] in the years before his death in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He flew it with his personal droid [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]] and used it for missions to places such as [[Abraxin]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] on missions to find [[Naat Lare]] and to kill [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] respectively.

Darth Plagueis gave the ship to Sidious to gift it to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]].
